# InventoryPro.in

Restaurant inventory, production and food-cost control software for Indian restaurants and cloud kitchens.

## What this site offers
- A live, clickable prototype of InventoryPro.in seeded with a full day of demo restaurant data
- An owner's command dashboard comparing wastage, production volume and POS sales side by side
- Batch-level recipe (BOM) costing, raw-material receiving/issuing, wastage logging and POS reconciliation
- A demo-request form that emails enquiries directly to the founder
- WhatsApp contact at +91 99086 59651 for booking a live walkthrough
